title.en: Lock classroom time to Los Angeles and enforce zero-warning source quality
title.zh: 锁定课堂洛杉矶时区并实施源码零告警质量门禁

purpose.en: Publish the shared classroom timezone correction on SmartLingo, remove retired or unused implementation paths, and prevent future releases when authored source has any ESLint error or warning.
purpose.zh: 在 SmartLingo 发布共享课堂时区修复，清除已退役或未使用的实现路径，并在作者源码出现任何 ESLint 错误或告警时阻止后续发布。

en: Keep every class start time explicitly formatted in America/Los_Angeles instead of inheriting each visitor device timezone.
Run ESLint with a zero-warning threshold locally and in GitHub Actions before build and deployment.
Render first-party learning artwork, user avatars, chat attachments, and AI images through the maintained Next image component while retaining authenticated media support.
zh: 所有课堂开始时间明确使用 America/Los_Angeles 格式化，不再继承访客设备时区。
本地与 GitHub Actions 在构建和发布前均以零告警阈值运行 ESLint。
第一方学习图片、用户头像、聊天附件及 AI 图片改用维护中的 Next 图片组件，同时保留已登录媒体支持。

en: Class detail time display, language-safe component boundaries, class screen sharing effects, roster and playlist effects, AI/community media, lint configuration, regression tests, and the Cloudflare deployment workflow.
SmartLingo learning, colleges, 48,000-word vocabulary catalog, Clerk authentication, Stripe and crypto payment behavior, private class media, and isolated production services remain unchanged.
zh: 涉及课程详情时间显示、语言类型安全边界、课堂共享副作用、学员与播放列表副作用、AI/社区媒体、Lint 配置、回归测试及 Cloudflare 发布流程。
SmartLingo 学习功能、学院、48,000 词词库、Clerk 登录、Stripe 与加密支付行为、私有课堂媒体及独立生产服务保持不变。

en: Retain the explicit America/Los_Angeles classroom formatter and its regression contract for the cross-site timezone fix.
Remove an unused legacy playlist viewer, obsolete program copy, unused helpers/imports/types, and unsafe interface-language casts.
Stabilize client effects for class sharing, access managers, student rosters, crypto settings, challenge calendar timing, and playlist cleanup so state updates occur outside effect bodies.
Exclude only generated build/runtime assets and user-generated work directories from lint; authored app, component, library, script, and test source remains covered.
zh: 保留明确的 America/Los_Angeles 课堂时间格式化及其跨站时区修复回归合同。
删除未使用的旧播放列表查看器、过期课程文案、无用辅助函数/导入/类型及不安全的界面语言强制转换。
稳定课堂共享、访问管理员、学员名单、加密设置、挑战日历计时和播放列表清理的客户端副作用，避免在副作用主体内直接更新状态。
Lint 仅排除生成的构建/运行时资产与用户生成工作目录；应用、组件、库、脚本及测试作者源码继续全部受检。

en: Require ESLint 0 errors and 0 warnings, TypeScript no-emit typecheck, verified production build and artifact scan, complete repository tests, release-manifest validation, and shared site contracts.
Deploy through GitHub Actions to Cloudflare, verify production course and payment boundaries, and publish and re-read this exact bilingual Project release record.
zh: 要求 ESLint 0 错误/0 告警、TypeScript no-emit 类型检查、已验证的生产构建与产物扫描、全仓测试、发布清单验证及共享站点合同全部通过。
通过 GitHub Actions 发布至 Cloudflare，核对线上课程与支付边界，并写入后重新读取本次精确的中英文 Project 发布记录。

en: The global migration does not repeat the dedicated four-user realtime report; SmartLingo's existing classroom realtime behavior and site-isolated credentials are intentionally preserved.
zh: 本次全站迁移不重复专站四用户实时报告；SmartLingo 既有课堂实时行为与站点隔离凭据按要求保留。

en: Use SmartLingo's course-detail classroom surface and keep its America/Los_Angeles display contract rather than importing SmartMeeting room UI.
Preserve the untracked tutorial output and temporary work directories, and keep SmartLingo's GitHub Actions-to-Cloudflare release boundary.
zh: 使用 SmartLingo 自有课程详情课堂界面，并保持 America/Los_Angeles 显示合同，不导入 SmartMeeting 房间 UI。
保留未跟踪的教程输出与临时工作目录，并维持 SmartLingo 既有 GitHub Actions 至 Cloudflare 发布边界。
